score: title_bm25 + bullet_weight * bullet_bm25; Python float64 sum of serialized Lucene float32 scores
document_text: product_bullet_point only in an independent auxiliary BM25 index; null becomes empty text
engine: unchanged frozen Bm25Cli with the same locale analyzers, normalization, k1=1.2 and b=0.75
statistics: independent full-catalog field statistics; one locale-product document in each index; not BM25F
candidate_scope: same judged validation candidates as the frozen title baseline
tie_break: descending combined score, then ascending product_id

confidence.method: paired percentile bootstrap of locale-normalized query groups

hypothesis: adding low-weight bullet evidence improves mean validation NDCG@10 over title-only BM25
weight_rationale: single conservative auxiliary weight chosen before measurement; score scales differ by field so title dominance is not guaranteed
adoption_rule: recommend for the next development baseline only if overall paired delta CI95 is entirely above zero and no locale mean decreases; otherwise retain title-only
diagnostics: ten largest gains and ten largest regressions by NDCG delta with identity tie-break
tuning: one configuration and one hypothesis; no sweep, post-result weight changes, spelling, entity, neural, or test-set experiments
cost_protocol: report existing title index bytes plus new bullet index bytes; incremental bullet export/index/score time; combined-score time; rerun frozen title scorer and verify exact score artifact; no API or load claims
